adversarial_findings.question: Is Class B justified, or is a missing physical phase still being hidden?
adversarial_findings.finding: Class B is justified for the bounded soil-layer mechanism because STATEQ06 identifies an existing total-system owner and deterministic aqueous reconstruction from accepted coordinates. No physical storage, phase, constitutive law or transfer law is added or redefined.
